summary: Iteration 5 focused on ta/bn localization, localized filter option labels, collapsed sidebar tooltip, and 4-language switcher. Backend: 23/23 pytest pass (added 6 new parametrized tests for ta/bn: /api/standards?lang, /api/standards/{id}?lang, /api/recommend?lang). Confirmed Tamil (U+0B80-0BFF) and Bengali (U+0980-09FF) titles/scope/requirements/department/aspect returned; related_standards titles localized; recommendation matched_requirements localized while is_number/status/score remain ASCII; IS 8112:2013 still ranks top for '43 grade cement for RCC 43 MPa' in ta and bn. lang=en unchanged. Frontend: [data-testid=language-switcher] contains lang-en/lang-hi/lang-ta/lang-bn (labels EN / हि / த / বা). Clicking each updates localStorage bis-lang to en/hi/ta/bn and reactively re-renders UI, filter option LABELS (Textiles => ஜவுளি ta / বস্ত্র bn / वस्त्र hi) and standard data. Filter option VALUES stay English — selecting Textiles under ta returned 5 Textiles-only cards. Standard details page renders Tamil title/scope/requirements after ta switch. Brand 'BIS Recommender' remains English in all languages. Persists across reload. Collapsed sidebar (desktop 1920x1080) via [data-testid=sidebar-collapse-toggle] shows tooltip on hover (role=tooltip visible, text='Dashboard' in current lang). No React Router future-flag warnings. Regression: EN/HI still working, recommendation flow and details container intact.
critical_code_review_comments: Language switch triggers a re-fetch of standard data — quick consecutive clicks may race. In tests, allow ~500ms between click and read. Not a user-facing bug.
Recommendation 'reason' field intentionally not translated (per design). Consider documenting this in UI so ta/bn users aren't confused when reason stays in English.
seed_data_creation: Ran multiple recommendation queries under ta/bn/hi/en during testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Tamil range U+0B80-U+0BFF, Bengali U+0980-U+09FF, Devanagari U+0900-U+097F. Language-aware endpoints accept ?lang=en|hi|ta|bn (default en). Filter option values remain English across all languages; only labels localize (see /app/frontend/src/i18n/dataLabels.ts). Standard IDs reshuffle on reseed — resolve via GET /api/standards?search=... . localStorage keys: bis-lang, bis-theme, bis-sidebar. Tooltips use role=tooltip when sidebar collapsed.
